Evening hours at the tool library: a 12-week pilot

Open three evenings a week for 12 weeks, on a budget of $18K, and hire one paid coordinator at 20 hours a week. The one decision that cannot wait is the hire.

Where things stand

  • 140 of 420 members asked for evening hours in the autumn survey.
  • 0 evening visits today: the library closes at 17:00.
  • 9 volunteers have signed up for evening shifts; a three-evening week needs 12.

The plan

WeeksEvenings openStaffed by
1–42 a weekvolunteers and the coordinator
5–123 a weekvolunteers and the coordinator

The money

$18K for the pilot. 20 hours a week for 12 weeks is 240 hours, about $14K; about $4K covers lighting, a second key-safe and a printed rota.

The decision

Hire one coordinator, or run on volunteers alone? Recommended: hire. With 9 of the 12 shifts covered, a volunteer-only rota leaves one evening in four unstaffed.
